text: Wrapped in Morathi's shadows, this unit slowly withers while it fights. Stops below 50% health.
Grants "Shadow-Bound": units take damage over time in battle while above 50% health
Consecrated by the Hag Queen's own hand.
Cults founded by Morathi herself, once she is Queen of Whispers, begin with a Sanctum. It hides the cult from prying eyes and spreads Slaanesh's corruption. It cannot be built.
